name: death glare
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} targets one frightened creature she can see within 30 ft. of her. If the target can see the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or drop to 0 hit points.
